blocks.text: KORONADAL CITY – A speeding police patrol car that crossed while the traffic light was red hit a motorcycle in downtown Koronadal, killing an eight-year-old girl and wounding her grandmother. The collision occurred at around 6:40 a.m. on Tuesday at a traffic light intersection along General Santos Drive and Sinsuat Street in Barangay Zone 4, according to a police report, which identified the victims as “Mina,” 8, and her grandmother, Meriam Salan Antiquera, 51, both residents of Purok Silangan, Barangay Morales.
